title: 法兴银行：建议做多台湾加权指数，看好日本金融板块
speaker: Frank Benzimra

segments.en: Well, I would say in Asia, if I remain very at a very macro level, to have a long position on Taiwan versus Korea is one trade that we are proposing.
segments.zh: 在亚洲宏观层面，我们建议做多台湾市场、做空韩国市场。

segments.en: Another that we are reiterating is to have a long on the topics which is much more diversified especially with financial and banks being well represented versus the Nikkei on which three names are explaining most of the return.
segments.zh: 另一个策略是做多台湾加权指数，该指数更为多元化，金融和银行板块权重较高；而日经指数回报集中在少数几只股票上。

segments.en: So I think this is the kind of rotation that we are advocating now. The call on the topics, is that a call also in financials or is the financials overweight? No, something separates you that. The call on the two picks is a call on Japan.
segments.zh: 这是我们当前倡导的轮动方向。做多台湾加权指数是否也意味着看好金融板块？不，两者不同。做多台湾加权指数实际上是看好日本。

segments.en: It's a call on the boosting growth that earnings grows that we are seeing from more nominal growth, which actually it's a bearish on bond but it's quite bullish on earnings. And the topic is very diversified.
segments.zh: 这是基于名义增长推动盈利增长的观点，对债券偏空，但对盈利偏多。台湾加权指数非常多元化。

segments.en: It is not too concentrated into few names which are having the same kind of cyclical issues that we are finding in Korea. And then we have the banking sector, we have a number of other sectors that we lack within the topics.
segments.zh: 它不像韩国那样集中在少数面临周期性问题的个股上。台湾加权指数包含银行等多个韩国所缺乏的板块。
